svg.title: Panpipes E3 to E4, octagon-row, plain edge, sheet 3 of 4
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Panpipes, E3 to E4, octagon-row, plain edge, sheet 3 of 4. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves the plugs' places on the front faces, on the faces' outsides, which lie face up. Then black #000000 frees the parts.
